  (CAST(SUBSTR(last_driver_time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600 + CAST(SUBSTR(last_driver_time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(last_driver_time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) + CAST(SUBSTR(last_driver_time, 10, 3) AS INTEGER) / 1000)
